description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).

4-layer hand-wired (d=64, 8 heads): L0 attn gathers 7 prompt digits by absolute position, MLP detects slope a=dy/dx via equality tests; L1 gates (q-x1) by slope -> y=y1+a(q-x1); L2/L3 turn y into tens/ones digit one-hots gated by position. +-B constant dims plus a balance dim make LayerNorm ~identity. B=1e4.
Same circuit, B=1e3: LN approximation error causes 3 misses.
Same circuit, d_model=49, 7 heads, position one-hot reduced to 13 dims.
Attention sharpness S=6: attention leaks onto other positions, 82%.
Slope-gating margin M=9 (minimum that works since |q-x1|<=9).
Position-gate constant big=20 for ones-digit units. (Row was first mislabeled nobalance; this config is what actually ran.)
Ablation: drop the balance-dim correction so the stream mean is no longer 0 -> 0% (LayerNorm mean subtraction corrupts features).
B=5e4: float32 rounding in LN mean/var costs 3 examples.
big=5 (below the value range of the ones scalar); still 100% since the leaked tens logit is dominated.
d=48 with 48 heads of d_head=1: each head is a pure scalar position-pointer.

Final: compact 4-layer hand-wired (d=48, 8 heads, d_ff=36), B=1e4, S=20, M=9, big=20. L0 attn gathers 7 prompt digits by position; MLP0 detects slope via equality tests; MLP1 gates (q-x1) by slope; MLP2/3 turn y into tens/ones digit one-hots gated by position.
